note: Daily field surveys for Harr. Each local day the village posts a sheet of places from the discovery catalogue and a gentle goal ('record two places before dusk'). Which places and which goal is a pure function of the date. A record is a signed landmark.visited event at a place on the sheet, made before dusk (host local time). Nobody is ranked: the village counter only adds up records. Finishing a survey gives recognition and a line in the chronicle, never coins or items.

templates.title: One quiet find before dusk
templates.blurb: A slow day: choose either place and take your time there.
